entry.idea: Nyobolt builds batteries that charge extremely fast and last for thousands of cycles, aimed at power-hungry uses like AI data centres, robots and electric vehicles.
entry.lesson: When a new wave of power-hungry machines arrives, like AI hardware and robots, better batteries become a business on their own.
entry.name: Nyobolt

growth.basis: substitute: a funding round bigger than the last, reaching unicorn valuation
growth.reason: No revenue or customer growth numbers were found; the clearest signal is reaching a $1 billion valuation after a new funding round.

market.reason: AI data centres, robotics and electric vehicles are large, fast-growing markets worldwide that all need better batteries.

tech.reason: Building batteries with ultra-fast charging and thousands of cycles without degrading is advanced battery science that takes years to replicate.

sources.title: UK-based deeptech startup Nyobolt secures $30M to expand high-power energy solutions | Vestbee
Nyobolt £44m round boosts startup funding | Startupmag

entry.twist: Its batteries can go from 0 to 80% charge in under 5 minutes and react in under a millisecond, far faster than typical batteries, while lasting up to 4,000 full charge cycles.
entry.who_pays: Makers of data centre power systems, robots and electric vehicles pay to use Nyobolt's battery technology.
entry.why_now: AI data centres, robots and electric vehicles all need power fast and reliably, and demand for high-power batteries is rising quickly.
